stories.title: Untersuchung zu Zecken – Zecken breiten sich in höhere Lagen aus

en.title: Investigation into ticks – Ticks spreading to higher altitudes
en.summary: Based on over 900 reports, ticks are found at higher elevations in Graubünden than previously assumed.

stories.title: Drei Jahre nach dem 7. Oktober – Sein Sohn wurde ermordet – trotzdem will er nicht hassen

en.title: Three years after October 7 – His son was murdered – yet he refuses to hate
en.summary: A father whose son was killed maintains hope years after October 7 and chooses not to harbor hatred.

stories.title: Nach Krawallen in Bern 2025 – Von 24 auf 48 Stunden: Längere Polizeihaft wirft Fragen auf

en.title: After riots in Bern 2025 – From 24 to 48 hours: Extended police custody raises questions
en.summary: Police custody is being extended from 24 to 48 hours following unrest in Bern, prompting concerns about reduced time available for judicial proceedings.

stories.title: Jagd auf Pädokriminelle – Warnmeldungen aus den USA helfen im Kampf gegen Kindsmissbrauch

en.title: Hunt for child abusers – Warning reports from the USA help combat child abuse
en.summary: A nonprofit US organization provides Switzerland with thousands of annual reports about pedophilic activity to support efforts against child abuse.

stories.title: Neuwahlen abgewendet – Shiroka-Pula ist neue Staatspräsidentin von Kosovo

en.title: New Elections Averted – Shiroka-Pula Becomes New President of Kosovo
en.summary: Shiroka-Pula was elected president of Kosovo, preventing another round of early elections that would have been the fourth such occurrence in less than two years.

stories.title: DER ANDERE BLICK - Die CDU muss sich neu erfinden. Ob das gelingt, ist fraglich

en.title: THE OTHER VIEW - The CDU Must Reinvent Itself. Whether It Will Succeed Is Questionable
en.summary: Germany's chancellorship party, the CDU, is experiencing a sharp decline. Public confidence in the Christian Democrats has been exhausted.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Drei Jahre nach dem Terror vom 7. Oktober: Aus den Opfern wurden Angeklagte

en.title: COMMENTARY - Three Years After the October 7 Terror: Victims Have Become Defendants
en.summary: Three years after the October 7 attack, Hamas lost its military war against Israel militarily but achieved its political objectives, with support from allies in the West.

stories.title: Trägt Netanyahu eine Mitschuld am 7. Oktober? Eine Wahrheitssuche drei Jahre danach

en.title: Does Netanyahu bear responsibility for October 7? A search for truth three years later
en.summary: Recent investigations support suspicions that Israel's Prime Minister Netanyahu received warnings of a Hamas attack, yet a thorough accounting remains unlikely while he remains in office.

stories.title: Aux États-Unis, la femme condamnée à mort reprend connaissance après son exécution ratée

en.title: In the United States, woman sentenced to death regains consciousness after failed execution
en.summary: Christa Pike, a death row inmate in the U.S., regained consciousness and can speak six days after surviving two failed lethal injections, according to her lawyers.

stories.title: Après son exécution ratée aux Etats-Unis, la condamnée à mort Christa Pike a repris connaissance et parle

en.title: After her failed execution in the United States, death row inmate Christa Pike regained consciousness and is speaking
en.summary: Six days after two failed lethal injections, Christa Pike remains in critical condition on life support but is conscious and able to speak, her lawyers announced while requesting commutation of her sentence.

stories.title: Porté par ESH Médias, un nouvel hebdomadaire local verra le jour à Genève en 2027

en.title: Backed by ESH Médias, a new local weekly will launch in Geneva in 2027
en.summary: ESH Médias, which publishes several regional newspapers, announced plans to create a new weekly publication for Geneva starting in early 2027, replacing the GHI. The paper will be distributed to approximately 200,000 copies and focus on local concerns.

stories.title: ESH Médias prépare un nouveau journal hebdomadaire pour Genève

en.title: ESH Médias prepares a new weekly newspaper for Geneva
en.summary: ESH Médias announced a new weekly newspaper for Geneva starting in early 2027 to replace the GHI ending in December. The publication will address local Geneva concerns.

stories.title: Machtkampf an den Finanzmärkten: Die steigenden Anleiherenditen könnten die Aktienkurse bald in die Knie zwingen

en.title: Power struggle in financial markets: Rising bond yields could soon force stock prices to their knees
en.summary: Bond and stock markets sometimes appear contradictory, raising questions about what investors can learn from historical patterns when these asset classes diverge.

stories.title: Chat-GPT geht auf die Finanzbranche los: Verlieren die «Finance Bros» nun ihre Jobs?

en.title: Chat-GPT takes aim at the finance industry: Are "finance bros" now losing their jobs?
en.summary: OpenAI has launched an AI agent capable of performing many tasks typically handled by financial professionals, potentially affecting job prospects particularly for career entrants.

stories.title: Der USA-Chef von Bayer warnt davor, dass die Amerikaner die Medikamentenforschung der Welt nicht mehr subventionieren wollen: «Wir stehen am Beginn einer Neuordnung»

en.title: Bayer's USA chief warns that Americans no longer want to subsidize the world's drug research: "We are at the beginning of a reorganization"
en.summary: Bayer's US leader Sebastian Guth, who has significantly expanded the pharma division since 2018, expresses concerns about declining American support for global pharmaceutical research while maintaining ambitious growth plans.

stories.title: Wie extreme Linke und Terrorsympathisanten die Schülerproteste in Frankreich unterwandern

en.title: How far-left extremists and terror sympathizers infiltrate student protests in France
en.summary: Left-wing populists led by Jean-Luc Mélenchon target young voters by infiltrating student protests and legitimizing violence, potentially benefiting far-right political forces in presidential elections.
